zh.summary: 更新 Native 便携版随附的 Node.js 运行环境。
highlights: Windows、macOS 和 Linux 便携包随附 Node.js 24.22.3。
官方插件管理可用时，使用上游提供的设置入口。
upgradeNotes: Node.js 随 Portable 程序包更新。使用内核更新功能时，应用会按已安装的运行环境筛选可用内核。

en.summary: Updates the Node.js runtime included with Native Portable.
highlights: Windows, macOS, and Linux packages include Node.js 24.22.3.
Plugin settings use the official plugin manager when the installed core provides it.
upgradeNotes: The Portable package updates Node.js. The core updater filters offered cores against the installed runtime.
